sql:
with totals as (select r.Key as Id, Sum(r.Amount) as Total
from bench.rows() r
inner join bench.lookup() d on r.Key = d.Key
where r.Amount >= 2
group by r.Key
having Sum(r.Amount) > 0) select Id, Total, RowNumber() over (order by Total desc) as Position
from totals
qualify Position <= 2
order by Id
take 2
